verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox's own docs position it squarely for this story: it runs untrusted or agent-generated code in isolated Linux microVMs, explicitly so AI agent output, user uploads, or third-party scripts can run without exposing production systems. Supporting controls include per-agent Linux users for multi-agent isolation and configurable timeouts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees, and documentation of network/egress controls or isolation-boundary specifics beyond 'microVM'.
